blind.B1: No. GSE283853 is the in-vitro gain-of-function RNA-seq of iPSC-derived (414C2) myotubes overexpressing MAFA/MAFB/MAF vs mCherry (S2.10.p1, S3.3.p1, DA.p1). No sample carries an exercise factor; the exercise-related data (trained vs untrained/endurance vs power biopsies) are separate accessions GSE200398/phs001048 (DA.p1, S2.18). Packet A shows no exercise words in any column.
blind.B2: Four groups, n=3 each (12 cultures): pAV-mCherry control vs pAV-MAFA, pAV-MAFB, pAV-MAF. Paper DEG counts: MAFA 3,685; MAFB 2,289; MAF 4,446 vs control (S3.3.p2, Fig 4A).
blind.B3: No repeated measures. Each sample is an independent infected culture harvested on day 4 (S2.10.p1); the _1/_2/_3 suffix is a replicate number, not an animal or person. The title-suffix pairing candidate is a replicate index with no biological meaning, and the paper does not say replicates were matched across groups.
blind.B4: The paper does not say whether one joint model or pairwise fits were used. It states edgeR exact test in CLC (Empirical Analysis of DGE) with DEGs extracted among conditions (S2.10.p1); the CLC tool is pairwise by nature.
blind.B5: FDR-corrected P < 0.05; no fold-change cutoff stated; genes with zero counts in any sample excluded (S2.10.p1). Counts: 3,685 / 2,289 / 4,446 (S3.3.p2).

checks.evidence: Refusal matches B1: no exercise arm; transgene overexpression in culture is not an exercise mediator treatment in the sense of the open policy item (it is a TF gain-of-function).
No analysis was run. Levels recorded (mCherry/MAFA/MAFB/MAF, 3 each) match the paper and the GEO titles.

Mechanical flag pairing_key_candidate (title without grp level) is a replicate index; cultures are independent (S2.10.p1). The expression check is 'supported' (same-key r 0.22 vs -0.11) but this may reflect batch of infection and the paper gives no pairing; no stop reason rests on it. Flag can be dismissed, optionally noted.
Paper silent on joint vs pairwise (B4); nothing was fitted.
Suitability reports no batch/sex info; not relevant to the refusal.
Integer CLC 'Expression values' columns kept, quantile-normalized columns dropped; edgeR recommended consistent with S2.10.p1. Caveat that CLC integers are 'total counts' is stated.
paper_threshold FDR 0.05, no effect cutoff, locator S2.10.p1 matches B5.
HANDBACK lists paper counts 3,685/2,289/4,446 for MAF contrasts and claims no ours-vs-paper match since nothing ran.
'No exercise arm' is true and established from the paper (DA.p1, S2.18) and metadata (no exercise words in any column), not from a narrow check.

summary: GSE283853 是肌管中过表达 MAFA/MAFB/MAF 的体外实验,没有运动组,拒绝分析的理由成立。机械标记的配对键只是重复编号,培养物彼此独立,可忽略。阈值(FDR<0.05,无倍数变化阈值)与论文一致。
